description: Since 1922 , Rotarex has been the world leader in cylinder valves, pressure regulators and equipment for all gas applications. With nearly 2 000 employees worldwide , we support a wide range of industries including semiconductor, medical, automotive, food & beverage, energy, research and many others. Innovation, quality and customer satisfaction are at the heart of everything we do, making Rotarex a trusted partner for customers around the globe. Rotarex Firetec is dedicated to fire suppression solutions , developing products and systems designed to protect people, equipment and critical environments. Operating in an international and highly technical market, Firetec brings together engineering expertise, product innovation and customer-focused solutions to address evolving fire protection needs. As we continue to develop our Firetec activities internationally, we are looking for a Product Manager to help drive our product portfolio, support its development and contribute to future business growth. 📍 Location: 100% Remote, with approximately 15% international travel required. 💼 Your mission As a Product Manager you will be the business owner of the product portfolio, connecting customer and market needs with engineering, certification, operations, and sales to deliver safe, compliant, competitive, and profitable fire protection solutions. Your Responsibilities Will Include Product Strategy, Innovation & Portfolio Management Define product strategy, roadmaps and business plans; identify innovation opportunities, portfolio gaps and growth opportunities. Monitor product performance, profitability and competitiveness to drive portfolio priorities and investment decisions. Sponsor product development projects, defining business requirements, priorities, target cost and value proposition. Manage products throughout the complete lifecycle, from development and introduction through growth, maturity, continuous improvement and end-of-life. Technical & Upstream Product Management Act as product subject-matter expert for portfolio and business-model decisions, including supplier/technology partner scouting and validation, make-or-buy decisions, cost-out and manufacturing. Drive product cost optimization and contribute to pricing and cost-reduction strategies. Certification & Regulatory Management Define certification priorities and ensure alignment with applicable fire-protection standards and approvals (UL, FM, LPCB, VdS, EN, etc.). Monitor regulatory changes and their impact on products and market access. Market, Customer & Product Marketing Act as the voice/proxy of the customer, engaging with customers, distributors and Sales to capture requirements, application needs and market feedback. Define product positioning and value propositions; monitor market trends, competitors and potential partnerships. Commercial & Cross-functional Support Act as the product reference for Sales and support strategic customer projects. Coordinate product priorities across R&D, Sales, Marketing, Quality, Operations, Purchasing and Supply Chain. Digitalization, Connectivity & AI Drive product digitalization and knowledge connectivity across the organization. Champion AI adoption within Product Management to increase customer value, product visibility, operational efficiency and data-driven decision-making. Product Knowledge & Continuous Improvement Manage product information, configurations and technical/commercial documentation. Drive internal product training and continuous improvement based on customer feedback, field experience and quality performance. 🧠 Your profile Qualifications Leadership and teamwork: Assign tasks, negotiate, and engage in cross-functional teams Adaptability: Quickly shift focus to changing priorities with minimal stress Communication: Effectively transmit information, adapt to different audiences, and comfortable speaking in public Problem Solving: Identify problems promptly and actively seek solutions Commercial awareness and customer focus: Understand business success factors and prioritize customer needs Required Skills Degree in product design, engineering, or business administration 5-year experience in fire suppression or correlated industry (mandatory) Involved in dynamic product management Experience overseeing multiple elements of the product development lifecycle AI literacy at user level, with the ability to effectively use AI-powered tools in daily work Fluent in English, French and German will be considered an asset Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 ✨ What makes this role unique Responsibility for the full Product Lifecycle of Rotarex Firetec products and systems Cross-functional collaboration with R&D, Production, Marketing, Purchasing and Sales Involvement in product development, product launches and business planning A role combining product management, technical and commercial activities Opportunities to contribute to product positioning, differentiation, costing, pricing and portfolio rationalization strategies Direct involvement in understanding customer needs, market trends and competitor offerings 🌟 What you will find at Rotarex The opportunity to join a global industrial group with more than 100 years of expertise and a strong international presence A 100% remote working environment, offering flexibility and autonomy in the way you organize your work An international and highly collaborative role, working closely with teams, customers and partners across different countries and functions A role with real ownership and visibility, where you can directly contribute to product strategy, development and business growth A dynamic environment combining technical expertise, innovation and customer focus Opportunities for continuous learning, professional development and career growth within an international organization The opportunity to connect face-to-face with colleagues, customers and partners Recruitment process Only applications submitted through our official application process will be considered. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidentiality. A small tip: AI-generated applications often sound alike… let your personality and experience make the difference ;) Ready to make an impact in an international product management role? Join Rotarex and help shape the future of our Firetec products and solutions!

description: Overview L’écosystème CBTW : Chez CBTW, entreprise mondiale de conseil en technologie, la collaboration est la pierre angulaire de l’innovation et du succès, et le fondement de tout ce que nous mettons en œuvre. Notre mission : transformer les entreprises et les communautés pour un monde meilleur. Présents dans plus de 20 pays et 35 villes, nous allions une expertise mondiale avec une compréhension locale des enjeux de nos clients, nous permettant de transformer les défis d’aujourd’hui en succès de demain. Responsibilities Que ferez-vous ? Recueil des besoins : Collaborer avec les parties prenantes métier afin de comprendre leurs objectifs, leurs besoins et leurs enjeux. Mener des entretiens, des ateliers et des recherches pour recueillir, analyser et documenter les exigences fonctionnelles et techniques. Conception et documentation des solutions : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes et les équipes de développement afin de traduire les besoins métier en spécifications fonctionnelles détaillées, cas d’utilisation et user stories. Documenter les exigences fonctionnelles et non fonctionnelles, les processus métiers ainsi que les modèles de données. Collaboration et communication : Collaborer efficacement avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires afin d’assurer la mise en œuvre et l’intégration réussies des solutions informatiques. Maîtrise des méthodologies : Connaissance des méthodologies Agile, Kanban, Scrum, Waterfall et Lean, ou expérience dans la conduite du changement au sein d’équipes matricielles utilisant des approches Agile ou en V. Bonne connaissance des méthodologies de gestion de projet telles que PMI, Scrum ou Prince2. Tests et assurance qualité : Soutenir l’équipe de test en participant à la revue des cas de test, à l’exécution des tests fonctionnels et aux phases de recette utilisateur (UAT) afin de valider que les solutions mises en œuvre répondent aux exigences métier. Qualifications Qui êtes-vous ? Une connaissance approfondie du secteur bancaire (paiements, comptabilité, réglementation) est indispensable. Excellente maîtrise du SQL pour interagir avec les bases de données, exécuter des requêtes et réaliser des analyses ainsi que des manipulations de données. Les certifications ECBA, CCBA ou CBAP constituent un atout. Certification Agile PSPO appréciée. Maîtrise courante du français et de l’anglais. Vous justifiez d’au moins 5 ans d’expérience en tant que Business Analyst. Vous êtes titulaire d’un Master ou d’un diplôme d’ingénieur en informatique (une expérience en alternance est un plus). Que vous proposons-nous ? ÉVOLUTION Un accompagnement personnalisé tout au long de votre carrière chez CBTW. Un catalogue varié de formations techniques et comportementales (hard & soft skills), des cours de langues individuels, un accès illimité à des plateformes d’e-learning (Udemy, Code Academy, etc.) ainsi que la possibilité d’obtenir une certification chaque année. COLLABORATION L’opportunité de rejoindre la communauté des Business Analysts et de participer à des sessions de partage de connaissances, événements, ateliers et autres initiatives. La possibilité d’intégrer l’un de nos collectifs (Bien-être, Agile, RSE, Gaming, etc.) et de partager vos centres d’intérêt avec d’autres passionnés. EN PLUS DE TOUT CELA Une rémunération compétitive accompagnée d’un package mobilité flexible, vous permettant de choisir parmi plusieurs avantages tels qu’une voiture électrique, un vélo électrique ou un abonnement aux transports en commun. L’opportunité d’évoluer au sein d’une équipe en pleine croissance, passionnée par les nouvelles technologies et l’innovation.

description: Job Type Permanent Build a brilliant future with Hiscox About Hiscox As an international specialist insurer, we are far removed from the world of mass-market insurance products. Instead, we are selective and focus on our key areas of expertise and strength, underpinned by a culture that encourages us to challenge convention and always look for a better way of doing things. We insure the unique and the interesting. And we search for the same when it comes to talented people. Hiscox is full of smart, reliable human beings that look out for customers and each other. We believe in doing the right thing, making good and rebuilding when things go wrong. Everyone is encouraged to think creatively, challenge the status quo and look for solutions. Scratch beneath the surface and you will find a business that is solid, but slightly contrary. We like to do things differently and constantly seek to evolve. We might have been around for a long time (our roots go back to 1901), but we are young in many ways, ambitious and going places. Some people might say insurance is dull, but life at Hiscox is anything but. If that sounds good to you, get in touch. About The Team The Change Management Team collaborate with all areas of the London Market business unit to design and build market leading capabilities across our people, processes and systems. Our goal is to embed lasting changes that deliver measurable benefit to our customers and help us reach our strategic goals. Working on our team is exciting and fast-paced. We shape and build the future of the London Market. The role We are seeking an experienced Product Owner to join our Claims value stream and help shape the next stage of its digital journey. Reporting to the Product Owner Chapter Lead, you will work with business, technology and data teams to translate strategy into clear priorities and measurable outcomes. Building on an established Claims platform, you will own the product roadmap from discovery through delivery and adoption. You will identify opportunities to improve Claims processes and user experiences while balancing immediate priorities with the longer-term product vision. You will also explore how AI, data science and emerging technologies could support the future development of Claims. This is an opportunity to shape new ideas, influence product direction and deliver improvements that create tangible value for users and the wider business. You will be collaborative, commercially minded and comfortable managing changing priorities, risks and dependencies. This is an exciting opportunity to help shape the future of Claims within the London Market. Key Responsibilities Own and proactively manage a complex, multi‑stream product backlog aligned to strategic objectives and OKRs, ensuring there is a steady flow of work for the delivery team. Translate ambiguous business problems into clear, outcome‑focused delivery goals Ensure sprint goals are clear, achievable, and aligned to roadmap milestones Conduct workshops to design and define delivery iterations, assess value, ensure work is prioritised and focused on delivering maximum value to our customers Capture requirements as increments of delivery and refine with the delivery team; ensure they are well thought through with clear acceptance criteria to ensure requirements are met Be the first point of contact for the delivery team to answer questions, clarify requirements and remove blockers. Act as the voice of the customer, ensuring everyone understands the business value of the delivery increments and represent the needs of our customers on a day to day basis within the delivery team Attend and participate in Agile events – stand ups, refinement, planning and retrospectives and work with the Scrum Master to ensure that these are successful Provide feedback on the roadmap to the Product Manager, escalating risks, issues and blockers raised by the delivery team and advising on actual vs. expected progress and any knock-on impact to the product roadmap Develop, manage and motivate a delivery team (in a matrix organisation) across internal and external teams, including third party suppliers Build strong, productive relationships inside and outside of Hiscox in order to deliver effective solutions based on a strong understanding of the business drivers and benefits for each party Partner with stakeholders across the London Market to shape scope, manage expectations, and drive alignment Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders, providing insight on trade‑offs, sequencing, and delivery options Coach and support less experienced Product Owners and contribute to Product Owner Chapter standards, capability development and continuous improvement. Key Requirements This role will suit you if you are comfortable working in a rapidly evolving and fast paced environment and enjoy delivering transformations that drive real benefit to our customers. You will need to be able to think on your feet, ruthlessly prioritise a development pipeline and communicate this effectively with your stakeholders and delivery team. Must haves Experienced Product Owner with direct experience in a similar Claims role and a proven track record of delivering value through cross-functional teams in complex digital product environments. Strong knowledge of the London Market is essential. Ability to operate in ambiguity, shape an emerging product direction and bring clarity to complex problem spaces Experience owning and developing a product roadmap, including enhancing an established platform and identifying opportunities for future development. Ability to balance competing priorities manage dependencies and maintain progress towards longer-term Claims outcomes whilst ensuring that best practices are maintained Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence Claims, technology and data stakeholders. A customer-centric approach to problem-solving, with the confidence to challenge the status quo and improve existing Claims processes. Experience using insight, user feedback and process analysis to identify opportunities and shape improvements to Claims products and journeys. Experience of working in Agile or iterative way, managing a backlog and ensuring business value is prioritised, successfully delivered and embedded Familiarity with OKRs, benefits tracking, and outcome‑led delivery Desirable Certified Agile Product Owner Experience working with Jira, Confluence or similar collaboration tools Experience working with emerging technologies or Data Science Diversity, Inclusion and Hybrid working At Hiscox we care about our people. We hire the best people for the job and we’re committed to diversity and creating a truly inclusive culture, which we believe drives success. We have also learned that working life doesn’t always have to be in the office and support hybrid ways of working to encourage a healthy work life balance. We anticipate the successful candidate for this role will be in the office approximately 2 days a week We see it as the best of both worlds: structure and sociability on one hand, and independence and flexibility on the other. You can follow Hiscox on LinkedIn, Glassdoor and Instagram (@HiscoxInsurance) Work with amazing people and be part of a unique culture

description: Landmark Digital is the dynamic digital arm of Landmark Group - Retail, serving as the cornerstone of our omnichannel business strategy. Headquartered in Dubai, UAE, with a strong technology and development hub in Bengaluru, we build and scale digital products, platforms, and experiences that power our retail businesses across multiple markets. We oversee the digital landscape of eight leading brands across diverse geographies, with ambitious plans for expansion into new territories and functions. Joining us means becoming a vital part of the Middle East's most significant bricks-to-clicks success story, boasting an impressive year-on-year growth rate exceeding 100%. Comprising a talented workforce of over 700 professionals across diverse domains, Landmark Digital spearheads various functions including Enterprise and E-commerce Tech, Product Management, User Design, and MarTech, among others. With our futuristic outlook, we are committed to delivering seamless digital experiences to our customers. At Landmark Digital, we cultivate an agile work culture, empowering you to make impactful decisions from day one within collaborative squads comprising professionals from over 20 nationalities. Additionally, our dedicated software development center in Bangalore, India, offers opportunities for incubation, design, and optimization of digital products. Working at Landmark Digital means engaging with cutting-edge technologies, including Enterprise and E-commerce tech, headless commerce, Java Spring Boot, React Native, React frontend, and Azure Cloud solutions, providing an enriching environment for professional growth and development. In addition to competitive remuneration and benefits, we prioritize continuous learning and growth through dedicated training and upskilling initiatives. Furthermore, our vibrant workplace culture fosters camaraderie through various team events, celebrations, and recreational amenities, ensuring a fulfilling experience both personally and professionally. Come be a part of Landmark Digital, where innovation, collaboration, and growth converge to redefine the digital retail landscape. Job Purpose To drive ecommerce business performance through data-led insights across the entire customer journey — from discovery and search, through category browsing and product pages, to cart and checkout. The role decodes how customers find, engage with, and purchase products, enabling the Product team to build a seamless, personalized, and high-converting experience across web and app. Critique, contextualize & communicate data insights to provide actionable recommendations. Answer not only the ‘what’ but also the ‘why’, ‘so what’ & ‘now what’. Job Description The Product Analyst will act as a key business partner to product management & business teams, working across the full ecommerce funnel — search & discovery, category/PDP navigation, merchandising, cart, and checkout. You will identify conversion gaps, uncover behavioral patterns, and design experiments that improve engagement, conversion, and revenue. Your insights will guide roadmap planning, UX enhancements, and feature prioritization across the platform. Key Responsibilities Analyze end-to-end customer journeys across web and app. Identify conversion gaps across search results, category pages, PDPs, cart, and checkout flows; propose and prioritize optimization experiments Partner with Product Managers, Business, UX, and Tech teams to define metrics for new features (filters, recommendations, personalization, payment options, etc.). Build and automate dashboards to track KPIs like traffic, add-to-cart rate, and sell-through. Design and run A/B tests across the funnel to drive higher CTRs, conversions. Investigate root causes of drop-offs (device, platform, geography, payment gateway) and recommend fixes. Identify conversion gaps across search results, category pages, PDPs, cart, and checkout flows; propose and prioritize optimization experiments. Knowledge, Skills & Experience Job Experience 5–8 years in product or ecommerce analytics, preferably in fashion, apparel, or lifestyle domains. Demonstrated impact on revenue, conversion, or funnel efficiency improvement through data-driven insights. Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Design, Tech, Business/Category, and Operations teams. Strong understanding of ecommerce trends, funnel metrics, discovery, and checkout workflows. Skilled in consumer behavior analytics, segmentation and cohort analysis. Comfortable with large datasets, hypothesis testing, and growth experimentation (A/B/multivariate testing). Required Skills Funnel analysis & optimization Clickstream & heatmap analysis Cohort and behavioral segmentation Language Proficiency in SQL, Python Visualization Tools: Looker, PowerBI Experience with Google Analytics, Amplitude/Mixpanel Strong collaboration, experimentation design & data storytelling

description: Job Purpose A World leader in air cargo. We possess a geographical advantage that enables us to reach over 140 destinations across 6 continents. We are able to cater to two-thirds of the world’s population in just 8 hours and serve major international trade regions quickly and efficiently. Our SkyCargo group works in partnership to facilitate global trade and connect customers with their destinations. We have a young, efficient, wide-bodied fleet, with ample capacity to transport cargo through our state-of-the-art, multi-airport hub in Dubai and adapt to our customers ever-changing needs. As Business Analyst , you will provide commercial analysis, market intelligence, and performance insights that support strategic and tactical decision-making, customer engagement, and measurable improvements in revenue, tonnage, customer retention, market share growth, and digital adoption. In This Role, You Will Analyse business performance data to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and performance variances, providing insights to support informed decision-making. Monitor and evaluate key performance indicators and business outcomes, highlighting gaps, identifying root causes, and supporting the development and tracking of improvement actions. Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and analytical tools to provide stakeholders with timely visibility of performance, trends, opportunities, and progress against objectives. Conduct market, customer, competitor, and business analysis to identify emerging trends, evolving requirements, and opportunities to enhance business performance and customer value. Provide analytical support for business planning, reviews, projects, and strategic initiatives, ensuring recommendations are supported by data, insights, and business requirements. Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to gather business requirements, validate findings, obtain market intelligence, and support the delivery of improvement initiatives and business objectives Manage relevant financial and administrative processes, including validation, stakeholder communication, issue resolution and mitigation of cost impacts. Qualification To be considered for this role, you must meet the below requirements: Degree or Honours (12+3 or equivalent) in Logistics, Cargo, Air Cargo, or a related field. Minimum 5+ years of relevant experience in Logistics, Cargo, or Air Cargo. Knowledge/Skills Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Data Analytics, Marketing, Finance, or a related discipline. Professional certification in Business Analytics, Data Analysis, Commercial Management, or Market Intelligence (Preferred). Experience in logistics, cargo, aviation, commercial analytics, or a related field; experience in commercial analysis, business performance reporting, market research, or a related analytical role; experience within aviation, logistics, cargo, or multinational commercial environments (preferred). Exposure to outstation commercial operations, customer interactions, and change initiatives (preferred for Cargo roles); demonstrated experience engaging with customers, supporting account reviews, and presenting commercial insights and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders. Experience working across functions and geographies, with the ability to convert analysis into owned actions and measurable commercial outcomes. Knowledge of commercial performance metrics, market analysis techniques, reporting methodologies, and business planning processes. Understanding of aviation cargo markets, customer segmentation, and competitive market dynamics (Preferred for Cargo); awareness of cargo operations and the interdependencies between operational and commercial activities (Preferred for Cargo). Knowledge of customer relationship management principles, customer segmentation, and account performance management (Mandatory). Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; advanced data analysis and reporting capabilities. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, CRM tools, and relevant commercial or reporting systems. Effective written and verbal communication skills; strong customer engagement, stakeholder management, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex insights clearly and influence action. Willingness and ability to undertake regular business travel across Europe and other assigned markets, based on business requirements. Preferred Skill Data visualisation and dashboard development skills (e.g., Power BI). Stakeholder management and presentation skills. Ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights. At Emirates, we're committed to providing our employees with opportunities to grow and develop in their careers. So if you're looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity, apply today and join our team! Salary & benefits Join us in Dubai and enjoy an attractive tax-free salary and travel benefits that are exclusive to our industry, including discounts on flights and hotels stays around the world. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers
